messages:
Maya (Docs): Quick heads-up — opened a PR to update SDK snippets + microcopy for parameter naming. We're standardizing on `prompt` (instead of `prompt_template`) and tightening voice in examples. Need quick acceptance so snippet CI doesn't fail. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

Ethan (SDK): Looks good at a glance. Two quick q's: 1) do we keep aliasing for a release for backwards compat? 2) confirm casing: `prompt` (snake_case) across SDKs?

Priya (Platform): @Ethan I'd prefer keeping an alias for one release, Platform will route both at runtime for now. We should add a deprecation note in docs and a short migration snippet.

Tom (Eng): Runtime already accepts both keys (we added an alias layer last quarter), so removing old key client-side won't be immediate-breaking. We can signal deprecation for one release window (e.g., v1.12.0 -> v1.13.0).

Luca (Design): Microcopy suggestions: use active voice and concise imperative for examples. Eg change 'You should provide a prompt' -> 'Provide a prompt'. Also please keep the one-line quickstart variant in each language SDK page.

Maya (Docs): Agreed. Drafting the deprecation blurb like: 'Note: `prompt_template` is deprecated in favor of `prompt`. The SDK will accept `prompt_template` for one release for backward compatibility.' Anyone want a shorter wording?

Ethan (SDK): Proposed short wording: '`prompt_template` (deprecated): use `prompt`. The SDK accepts `prompt_template` for one release for compatibility.' That fits the snippet header.

Priya (Platform): :thumbsup: Add a tiny migration snippet showing old -> new, e.g.:

```
// old
client.generate({ prompt_template: "Translate to French: {{text}}" })

// new
client.generate({ prompt: "Translate to French: {{text}}" })
```

Maya (Docs): I'll add the snippet + update the quickstart one-liner and the microcopy change now. Pushing a new commit to the PR in a minute.

deploy-bot: Snippet linter queued for PR #1234 — running checks, ETA ~5m.

Tom (Eng): :eyes: Can someone add a short note in the release notes section? I'll mark runtime as compatible but call out the deprecation. I'll add a small internal flag so infra teams know the alias stays on until v1.13.0.

Ethan (SDK): I'll add a CHANGELOG entry under 'SDK migration' with the exact wording and the target releases.

Maya (Docs): Thanks — plan: merge tomorrow EOD if no objections. Will include: deprecation blurb, migration snippet, updated quickstart one-liner, and the active-voice microcopy edits across examples. Marking PR ready for review. :rocket:

Luca (Design): Nice, thanks Maya. Small nit: ensure example outputs still match after wording tweak.

Maya (Docs): Will double-check outputs in the examples and fix any differences before merge. If the linter passes, I'll request reviews.

Ethan (SDK): No objections from SDK side.

Priya (Platform): No objections from Platform.

Tom (Eng): Good from runtime.

Maya (Docs): Great — thanks everyone!
